prompt:

Return JSON with 'severity' and 'reason'.

INQUIRY: "Phone freezes all the time now. I'll be in the middle of typing an iMessage & it just stops typing, then jolts back to life like a frozen computer. All of my apps freeze as well. Snapchat/tinder the most. This is literally the worst update ever for a phone. @AppleSupport #ios1103"
Output JSON: {"severity": "<routine|frustrated|severe>", "reason": "<one_line_explanation>"}
